integrity: The proof is symbolic and uses the published definition of the homomorphisms together with the standard pure-braid abelianization; no experimental extrapolation is used.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is for bonded braids with pure forgetful image and positive bond degree, and distinguishes oriented closures. It does not classify the resulting links beyond the linking-vector obstruction or address arbitrary component-orientation reversals.
title: Bond degree is the linking-number speed of the bonded-braid power family
